name: Vincennes (United States)
description: Navy blue field charged at the centre with the city seal: a red disc bearing a white letter V and fleurs-de-lis, within a scalloped ring of red and white reading VINCENNES INDIANA.
history: Vincennes is a city in and the county seat of Knox County, Indiana.
